biggest_catch: The payout depends entirely on the referred business's annual usage — a small business (15-49 MWh) earns you only $25; the $1,000 tier requires a referred business using 5,000+ MWh a year — and the referred business must stay current and in good standing for two billing cycles.
catches: The referred business must be new to AEP Energy, use at least 15 MWh annually, and sign an energy purchase agreement of at least 12 months.
The referred business's account must remain current and in good standing for two monthly billing cycles after enrollment before you earn anything.
You must be a current AEP Energy customer at the time of the bill credit award.
Bill credit is issued within 90 days of the referred business's enrollment — it is not instant.
Referral Rewards are not redeemable for cash, are non-transferable, and you are responsible for any applicable taxes.
Program terms are subject to change at AEP Energy's sole discretion; confirm the tier table is current before referring.
